Welcome to ARISE Veterinary Center in Queen Creek
At ARISE Veterinary Center, we are deeply committed to providing exceptional emergency and specialty veterinary care for every pet that walks through our doors. We do that with the use of veterinary medicine by utilizing the latest advancements in technology and treatment, ensuring that every animal receives personalized attention tailored to their unique needs. ARISE and our state-of-the-art AAHA Level 1 accredited hospital is unlike anything. This achievement helps us to keep human standards in our hospitals, to dedicate themselves to continuing education, passionately focused on advancing the healthcare of pets.
As a 24-hour emergency and specialty animal hospital serving Queen Creek, Gilbert, Chandler, Mesa, and the greater East Valley, we believe in the power of partnership and working collaboratively with pet parents and their primary care veterinarians (pDVMs) to promote comprehensive medical plans that prioritize the health and well-being of each pet. With a team of dedicated professionals who take a vow to do no harm, we are here to support our patients and their families.

Client Testimonials & Reviews
We value our clients’ experience at ARISE Veterinary Center. Here’s what some of your neighbors are saying about us.
ARISE took care of our Daisy better than I could imagine. EVERY PERSON we dealt with was kind, compassionate and clearly care about pets and owners as well. I truly wish I could individually name every person, they all were wonderful.  Every step of care was explained in detail, along with the estimated cost. There was no 'selling' of their services, it was all about taking care of my very sick puppy. Being that she had to stay over night, I was given detailed updates regularly. Follow up calls were made as well, with obvious sincerity. I will not hesitate to take Daisy to ARISE in the future if necessary and I very much recommend ARISE Vet Center in Queen Creek!
Marilyn D.
Miriam, Brandi, and all of the doctors and vet techs took fantastic care of my puppy, Roxy, during her recent spay procedure. They had excellent communication, clear instructions for post op medication schedules, and returned a happy but sleepy puppy who is healing well. Very thankful that Arise takes such good care of my dogs!
Hamilton H.
ARISE saved my senior cat's life when she suffered a massive seizure in the middle of the night. Dr. Swanson, Hannah, Lauren, and the rest of the team who worked the night of 12/16/23 were literal lifesavers! It's very reassuring to have a 24/7 emergency hospital available at a moment's notice when situations such as this happen. Thank you to everyone who helped Posey that night; I'm eternally grateful to all of you because Sunday morning might have turned into a much darker outcome for her without your help.
Lauren S.
